options.content: **Posture panels (dưới)** chạy ngay khi có Grafana **PostgreSQL datasource** (role read-only `zabbixmonitor`/`pg_monitor`) — đọc catalog, không cần pgAudit. **Lớp audit-log** (auth failures, truy cập `hr.hr_salary`, DDL, đổi quyền) là **Zabbix triggers** (cần bật pgAudit + logrt items) → hiện trên **SOC wall**. Cả hai lắp theo `docs/monitoring/runbook-db-perf-security.md`.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS superusers FROM pg_roles WHERE rolsuper;

panels.title: SUPERUSER roles (bất thường nếu ngoài postgres/dbadmin — vụ db_dev)

targets.rawSql: SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin, rolreplication FROM pg_roles WHERE rolsuper ORDER BY rolname;
SELECT rolname, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin FROM pg_roles WHERE (rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb) AND NOT rolsuper ORDER BY rolname;
SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolvaliduntil, rolconnlimit FROM pg_roles WHERE rolcanlogin AND rolname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' ORDER BY rolsuper DESC, rolname;

panels.title: Live connections by user + client IP

targets.rawSql: SELECT usename AS usr, client_addr, datname AS db, application_name AS app, COUNT(*) AS conns, MAX(backend_start) AS newest_conn FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE client_addr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY usename, client_addr, datname, application_name ORDER BY conns DESC;
SELECT line_number AS ln, type, array_to_string(database,',') AS db, array_to_string(user_name,',') AS usr, address, auth_method, error FROM pg_hba_file_rules ORDER BY line_number;

panels.title: Audit-log layer (pgAudit → Zabbix triggers → SOC wall)

options.content:
Các tín hiệu audit dưới đây **không phải panel Grafana** mà là **Zabbix triggers** (tag `service:postgres-security`) — bật pgAudit + `logrt[]` theo `runbook-db-perf-security.md`, cảnh báo hiện lên **SOC wall**:

| Cảnh báo | Nguồn | Severity |
|---|---|---|
| **Superuser set đổi** (chống lặp db_dev) | catalog snapshot `pg_roles` | Disaster |
| Role/quyền đổi (GRANT/ALTER/CREATE ROLE) | pgAudit `role` class | High |
| Truy cập `hr.hr_salary` | pgAudit OBJECT (scope bảng nhạy cảm) | High |
| DDL trên schema prod (hr/finance) | pgAudit `ddl` class | Average/High |
| Auth failures (brute force) | log `password authentication failed` | High |
| **HBA reject** = user kết nối từ IP ngoài dải đã ghim | log `pg_hba.conf rejects connection` | High |
| pg_hba file đổi / có rule `0.0.0.0/0` | `vfs.file.cksum` + content check | Warning/Disaster |

> pgAudit chỉ bật session-class `ddl, role, misc_set` (KHÔNG bật `write/read` toàn cục — tránh nhiễu + tải); audit bảng nhạy cảm scope qua pseudo-role `pgaudit`.
